publicFacts.detail: Unity Gardens is a fictional residential community in Abuja, Nigeria. It began as a modest development on the outskirts; homes were occupied gradually and small businesses grew around everyday needs.

At the start of the simulation, apartment blocks and standalone homes share a neighbourhood with market trading, transport, repairs, supply work, care, teaching and tailoring. Residents have different means and priorities; ordinary trade and services are functioning.
